\chapter{A Six-Field Profile}
\label{ch:mr-a1-practical-form}
\hlchaptermodality{25}

\begin{chapteropening}
\textbf{By the end of this chapter:} \emph{I can independently choose and write six requested Marathi profile values in Devanagari without a value bank or completed model.}

Complete a new six-field Marathi profile from support-language meanings alone, with printed labels but no copyable answers.
\end{chapteropening}

\section[\mr{नाव} · \mr{शहर} · \mr{भाषा}]{Choose the first three answers}

\label{lesson:MR-A1F04-first-three-select}



\begin{quote}
Read three known labels: \textbf{\mr{नाव}}, \textbf{\mr{शहर}}, \textbf{\mr{भाषा}}. Today you choose what each row asks for; you do not yet write the whole form.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn — one profile, three choices}
Profile A says in the support language: \textbf{name Arun; city Pune; language Marathi}. Point to the matching detail when each Marathi label is shown. Keep the profile card open. There is no Marathi answer bank to copy.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Stop after three meaning choices.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\mr{आवडते} \mr{पेय} · \mr{आवडती} \mr{कृती} · \mr{मित्राचे} \mr{नाव}]{Choose the last three answers}

\label{lesson:MR-A1F05-last-three-select}



\begin{quote}
Say the three jobs once: favorite drink, favorite activity, friend's name. Keep \textbf{-\mr{ते}}, \textbf{-\mr{ती}}, and \textbf{-\mr{चे}} attached to the printed labels.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn — one profile, three choices}
Profile A says: \textbf{favorite drink tea; favorite activity reading; friend Mira}. Choose the requested detail for each Marathi label. Do not write a full row yet.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Stop before entry begins.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\mr{नाव}: \_\_\_ · \mr{शहर}: \_\_\_ · \mr{भाषा}: \_\_\_]{Enter the first three values}

\label{lesson:MR-A1F06-first-three-supported}



\begin{quote}
Keep Profile A visible: \textbf{Arun; Pune; Marathi}. The card gives meanings, not copyable Devanagari answers.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — supported controlled composition}
Complete only these rows:

\begin{quote}
\textbf{\mr{नाव}: \_\_\_\_\_\_}
\end{quote}

>

\begin{quote}
\textbf{\mr{शहर}: \_\_\_\_\_\_}
\end{quote}

>

\begin{quote}
\textbf{\mr{भाषा}: \_\_\_\_\_\_}
\end{quote}

Choose the requested known value and write it in Devanagari. The labels stay visible because they are the form, not an answer model.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Stop after three rows.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\mr{अरुण} · \mr{पुणे} · \mr{मराठी}]{Repair one value, not the whole form}

\label{lesson:MR-A1F07-first-three-spelling}



\begin{quote}
Cover yesterday's entries. Say which row held the first spelling difference. Do not recopy a correct row.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — bounded spelling repair}
Write only the failed value from \textbf{name · city · language}. Compare in three passes: base letters, vowel signs, then the final headline. If it is correct, write the next requested value once instead.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
One repair pass is enough.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\mr{आवडते} \mr{पेय}: \_\_\_ · \mr{आवडती} \mr{कृती}: \_\_\_ · \mr{मित्राचे} …]{Enter the last three values}

\label{lesson:MR-A1F08-last-three-supported}



\begin{quote}
Keep Profile A visible: \textbf{tea; reading; Mira}. Say the three printed label endings once: \textbf{-\mr{ते}}, \textbf{-\mr{ती}}, \textbf{-\mr{चे}}.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — supported controlled composition}
Complete only the three blank value spaces. The support-language card chooses the meanings; you supply the known Marathi spellings. No Marathi answer bank is visible.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Stop after three rows.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[-\mr{ते} · -\mr{ती} · -\mr{चे}]{Repair endings before values}

\label{lesson:MR-A1F09-last-three-agreement}



\begin{quote}
Cover the values. Look only at the labels and say: neuter drink \textbf{-\mr{ते}}, feminine activity \textbf{-\mr{ती}}, neuter name \textbf{-\mr{चे}}.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — bounded agreement repair}
Complete only these endings: \textbf{\mr{आवड}\_\_ \mr{पेय} · \mr{आवड}\_\_ \mr{कृती} · \mr{मित्रा}\_\_ \mr{नाव}}. Do not rewrite tea, reading, or Mira. This pass repairs grammar separately from value spelling.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Stop before values return.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\mr{नाव}: \mr{अरुण} · \mr{शहर}: \mr{पुणे} · \mr{भाषा}: \mr{मराठी}]{Delay the first three entries}

\label{lesson:MR-A1F10-first-three-delayed}



\begin{quote}
Read Profile A once: Arun, Pune, Marathi. Close it and wait ten seconds.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — delayed controlled composition}
With only the three printed Marathi labels visible, fill all three values from the delayed profile. There is no romanization and no completed row to copy. Compare only after all three values are written.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Stop after one delayed attempt.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\mr{आवडते} \mr{पेय}: \mr{चहा} · \mr{आवडती} \mr{कृती}: \mr{वाचणे} …]{Delay the last three entries}

\label{lesson:MR-A1F11-last-three-delayed}



\begin{quote}
Read Profile A once: tea, reading, Mira. Close it and wait ten seconds.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — delayed controlled composition}
Fill the three values with only the blank form visible. Compare in two passes afterward: requested value first, then the printed \textbf{-\mr{ते} / -\mr{ती} / -\mr{चे}} forms.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Stop after one delayed attempt.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[six-field Marathi profile]{Join the two halves}

\label{lesson:MR-A1F12-six-field-supported}



\begin{quote}
Keep Profile A visible. The first three and last three rows have already passed separately; today the only new load is joining them.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — supported six-field composition}
Complete the six blank Marathi rows from the support-language profile. There is no Marathi value bank or completed example. Check rows 1–3, pause, then rows 4–6. Repair only the first failed half.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
The independent profile changes next time.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[independent six-field Marathi profile]{Complete a new six-field form}

\label{lesson:MR-A1F13-six-field-independent}



\begin{quote}
Profile B says: \textbf{name Mira; city Pune; language Marathi; favorite drink milk; favorite activity writing; friend Arun}. These meanings are the task. No Marathi values are displayed.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — independent controlled composition}
Complete the six printed Marathi labels from Profile B. There is \textbf{no romanization, Marathi answer bank, or completed model}. Do not reveal the answer while scoring. The task is untimed; timing belongs to the later checkpoint issue.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
This proves untimed practical-form composition only. It does not claim timed writing or full A1 readiness.
\end{tcolorbox}
